stitch.description: Google Stitch — generates Figma-faithful UI variants from prompts + Figma context. Used to benchmark 3 layout alternatives per slide in BrandMorph.

figma.description: Figma Developer MCP — extracts variables, auto-layout, Code Connect metadata. BrandMorph uses it to parse figma_full_file.json → tokens.

vercel.description: Vercel MCP — deploy, env management, and log streaming for BrandMorph Studio. Production deploys on push to main.

github.description: GitHub MCP — PR diff inspection, commit history. Proves design→code velocity.

_meta.author: Akshay John Xavier — 8y Creative Technologist
_meta.usage: Cursor / Claude Code / Claude Desktop: copy this file to .cursor/mcp.json or claude_desktop_config.json. Requires: STITCH_API_KEY (Google AI Studio), FIGMA_API_KEY (Figma personal token), VERCEL_TOKEN (vercel.com/account/tokens)
